rationale: For an enterprise dashboard handling routes, compare, banking, and pooling, a dark high-contrast theme ensures readability, professional authority, and a modern 'control room' feel without overwhelming the user.

layout.spacing: Dense and compact. Use p-6 or p-8 for main containers, p-4 for cards.
layout.radius: rounded-sm (max 4px) to maintain a sharp, technical aesthetic.
layout.alignment: Left-align dense data, tables, and labels. Center align empty states.

surface_strategies.dashboard_cards: Flat background (#141414), 1px subtle border (border-white/10), no shadow. On hover, slight border color brighten to white/20.
surface_strategies.header: Solid Background (#0A0A0A) with a hard bottom border (border-white/10).

components.navigation: Top navigation bar with Logo (Lucide Icon) + 4 Tabs (Routes, Compare, Banking, Pooling).
components.tabs: Shadcn Tabs. Override default background. Use transparent background with bottom border for active state, or minimalist flat pills.
components.tables: Dense rows. Header uses text-xs font-mono uppercase. Row borders: border-b border-white/5. Hover state on rows: bg-white/[0.02].

buttons.primary: bg-white text-black hover:bg-gray-200 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-white/10 text-white hover:bg-white/5 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm transition-colors
buttons.action: bg-[#0055FF] text-white hover:bg-[#0044CC] rounded-sm px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium transition-colors

badges.compliant: border border-[#00FF66]/30 text-[#00FF66] bg-[#00FF66]/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium
badges.non_compliant: border border-[#FF3B30]/30 text-[#FF3B30] bg-[#FF3B30]/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium

motion.micro_interactions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out on all interactive elements (hover, focus, active).

testing.attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attribute in kebab-case (e.g., data-testid='routes-tab', data-testid='baseline-button').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI.
Use mock data locally since no DB is needed.
Setup FastAPI backend with mock in-memory data for the specified endpoints.
Ensure the dashboard uses dark mode permanently.
Apply the styling rules from this JSON carefully. Avoid rounded-lg or heavy shadows.
Do not use transparent backgrounds for the header without a solid background behind it.
